info.text:
Card buyers spent 88 cents more per vending sale than cash buyers in 2025.
On Cantaloupe's network, the average card sale was $2.45 vs $1.57 in cash; the overall average vending sale was $2.01.
Our math with example costs: a $1.00 snack, a 10% host commission (20¢) and a 5% card fee (10¢) leave about 71¢ before trucks, drivers and machines.
On that network, cashless hit 78% of vending sales in 2025, and Cantaloupe's payment volume grew from $1.8B (FY2021) to $3.4B (FY2025).
Cantaloupe has been part of 365 Retail Markets since May 2026.
Sources: Cantaloupe 2026 Micropayment Trends Report; Cantaloupe 10-K filings (SEC).
News and education, not financial advice.
